answer: Give every agent one non-transferable harbor pilotage: to enter the market it must complete a live, twenty-minute guided passage from river mouth to harbor, following unpredictable course corrections from a rotating pilot in real time. Each passage is sequential, single-threaded, and tied to one identity, so one operator cannot run fakes in parallel or hand the wheel to another; every extra fake costs another full twenty minutes of undivided pilot attention, making a Sybil fleet slower and costlier than the ocean trade it hopes to capture.
